thread:
zoe_sales: Heads-up: NovaShop wants a 5-day POC. Scope: streaming SDK demo that ingests OCR'd receipt text, uses function/tool calling to emit a strict JSON invoice (invoice_id, date, items[{sku, qty, unit_price}], subtotal, tax, total), SAML+SCIM for provisioning, EU data residency (eu-west), and a rough reserved-capacity price for ~200 qps peak. Can we start next Fri? :calendar:

  derek_se: Good outline. A few clarifying Qs: 1) average tokens per request (after OCR)? 2) concurrency vs qps (are they bursty?), 3) will they send images or already-extracted text?

  zoe_sales: They said ~120 tokens avg after OCR, mostly text (we'll ask them to OCR on-prem before sending), bursts up to 220 qps for <2min windows. They want SLA for <150ms P95 for lookup flow.

  anya_devx: We can demo with our Python streaming SDK + function-calling to enforce the invoice schema. Quick sample to show during the walkthrough (streaming + incremental function call info):

```py
# python pseudo-sample for demo
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=POC_KEY)

stream = client.responses.stream(
    model="redwood-small-1",
    input="Extract invoice JSON from this receipt text...",
    functions=[{
        "name": "normalize_invoice",
        "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
                "invoice_id": {"type": "string"},
                "date": {"type": "string", "format": "date"},
                "items": {"type": "array"},
                "total": {"type": "number"}
            },
            "required": ["invoice_id", "items", "total"]
        }
    }],
    stream_mode=True
)

for event in stream:
    # event may be partial tokens or a function call payload
    print(event)
```

  anya_devx: Demo tips: enable prefix caching for repeated receipt headers, set max_batch_tokens to keep latency low (e.g., 4k token window but batch timeout 6ms), and show quantization tradeoffs (int8 for cost demo, float16 for quality). Also show schema validation fail path -> fallback text response.

  kevin_security: Important: receipts can contain PAN fragments. Ask NovaShop to redact or tokenize card data before sending. PCI scope depends on whether cardholder data is in our environment. We'll provide SOC2 report and complete their questionnaire. If they insist on HSM-backed keys, that will add legal/infrastructure gating. Link to internal sec doc: https://redwood.internal/sec/presales-pci (internal).

  mike_infra: I can reserve a temporary Dedicated POC cluster in eu-west for the week. SCIM + SAML supported on Dedicated; will need their IdP metadata and SCIM base URL. Note: Dedicated provisioning for POC is subject to legal sign-off for sample contract (we have a short POC addendum).

  derek_se: Pricing note for presales: offer a time-limited trial credit for the POC. For production reserved capacity to handle sustained 200 qps with the latency SLO, rough ballpark (subject to infra sizing/finance) is ~€11k-€18k/month depending on GPU class and redundancy. I'll follow up with finance for a more precise quote.

  deploybot: infra-bot: dedicated-poc-eu-west queued for allocation (project: novashop-poc) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

  zoe_sales: Okay team — ask list for NovaShop: 1) SAML SP metadata + SCIM endpoint, 2) sample (redacted) OCR'd receipt text, 3) expected qps profile (minute-level), 4) security questionnaire (we'll send ours too). I'll request those now and propose Fri 09:00 CET kickoff.

  mike_infra: I'll proceed with the POC cluster once legal confirms the addendum. If they need dedicated HSM or KMS isolation, flag and we'll escalate.

  anya_devx: I'll prepare a short runbook: demo flow = (1) streaming ingest -> (2) function call normalize_invoice -> (3) schema validation -> (4) small load test showing p95 latency and fallback behavior. Will attach load script (locust/golang small client) after I finish.

  kevin_security: I'll start the security questionnaire and add PCI scoping guidance. Expect my draft by Thu EOD.

  zoe_sales: Perfect. Next actions: Ill send NovaShop our questionnaire + request metadata/sample text now. Mike hold the cluster queue until legal OK. Derek follow up pricing with finance. Anya prep runbook + load script. Kevin finish sec draft Thu EOD. Thanks! :rocket:
